business_objective: Relocate an existing appointment to an available room and close the request after the attendee acknowledges the updated location.

stakeholder_statements.text: The provider submits a room-change request for an existing appointment and identifies the appointment and requested room.
The facilities coordinator records the requested room as available or unavailable.
When the room is available, the scheduling clerk updates the appointment location and records the new room.
The attendee acknowledges the updated appointment location.

The appointment supervisor closes the room-change request only after the location update and attendee acknowledgement are recorded. Changing the appointment date and providing clinical care are outside this project.

business_objective: Review dormant-account reactivation requests and reactivate accounts after identity and risk checks are completed.

stakeholder_statements.text: An account holder submits a dormant-account reactivation request and identifies the account and reason for reactivation.
The branch service officer confirms that the account is dormant and records the supporting evidence. The accepted evidence types have not been agreed.
The identity reviewer records identity verification as passed or failed and adds a reason when it fails. The verification criteria are not finalized.
The risk officer records the risk review as cleared or referred and records any restriction. The risk categories are not finalized.

The account operations clerk reactivates the account only after dormant status, passed identity verification, and a cleared risk review are recorded, then sends the outcome to the account holder. The delivery channel is undecided. Opening new accounts and making lending decisions are outside this project.

business_objective: Review and apply replacement signature pages to eligible controlled-document versions after authenticity checks.

stakeholder_statements.text: A document author submits a signature-page replacement request and identifies the controlled document, current version, and replacement signature page.
The records clerk records the replacement reason and supporting evidence. The accepted evidence types have not been agreed.
The signature verifier records the replacement page as authentic or not authentic and adds a rationale when it is not authentic. The verification criteria are undecided.
The document controller replaces the signature page only when the current version is eligible for replacement and authenticity is confirmed. The version-eligibility rule has not been agreed.

The distribution clerk sends a replacement notice to the recipients of the current version, but the delivery channel is undecided. Editing the document body and collecting physical signatures are outside this project.

business_objective: Review volunteer requests to satisfy a safeguarding-training requirement through verified equivalent prior training.

stakeholder_statements.text: A volunteer submits a training-waiver request and identifies the required course and prior completion.
The program coordinator records the volunteer's service role and whether the training is currently required.
The training reviewer records evidence of prior completion and records whether the prior course is equivalent. The accepted evidence types and equivalence criteria have not been agreed.
The safeguarding officer records the waiver as approved or declined and adds a reason when it is declined.

The volunteer records clerk marks the training requirement satisfied only after an approved waiver is recorded, then sends the outcome to the volunteer. The delivery channel is undecided. Delivering training and conducting background screening are outside this project.

business_objective: Review property-repair inspection requests and prepare inspection arrangements while preserving an unresolved rule about releasing policyholder contact details.

stakeholder_statements.text: A policyholder submits a repair-inspection request and identifies the claim and damaged property area. The policyholder also records a preferred contact method.
The claims intake clerk records supporting evidence and records the request as complete or incomplete. The accepted evidence types have not been agreed.

The claims adjuster records the inspection as authorized or not authorized. The adjuster says policyholder contact details may be released to the repair liaison after authorization without separate consent.
The privacy reviewer records a disclosure assessment and any restrictions. The reviewer says policyholder contact details must not be released without explicit policyholder consent.

The claim operations officer records an inspection release after request completeness, inspection authorization, and the disclosure assessment are present, and the repair liaison then records a proposed inspection window. Nobody has decided who records consent, which contact fields may be shared, or the maximum release-decision time. Repair payment and contractor selection are outside this project, and the meeting also drifted into complaints about the parking signs.
